name: Bernstein
prior: Freeze-what-you-just-played exists in several forms: Eurorack granular/spectral buffers that scrub the recent past with Position and transpose by 1V/oct – Mutable Instruments Clouds (1–8 s buffer, Freeze, Position scrub, 1V/oct; VS: softube.com Clouds manual, modulargrid.net) and Beads (Freeze locks and loops the buffer, Position, 1V/oct; VS: modulargrid.net), Rossum Panharmonium (spectral resynthesizer of live input with Freeze, Blur = spectral lag, stored spectra playable with 1V/oct; VS: rossum-electro.com, perfectcircuit.com); guitar pedals EHX Freeze/Superego and Gamechanger Plus (sustain what you just played; A). Software: AudioThing Frostbite (4 freeze modes incl. spectral with randomised phases, iOS/AUv3 2024; VS: mwm.ai), isxynth (spectral morphing with freeze, iOS 2023; VS: synthanatomy), Chiral Audio Anderson Freeze (insert effect that pins the frozen bed to a root/chord shape = tuned freeze; VS: kvraudio.com), Spectral Freeze Pro (M4L, Feedback option freezes successive notes into a chord; VS: akihikomatsumoto.sellfy.store), Sampleson Tactile (spectral freezing engine played by trackpad; VS: synthtopia 2025), Muddlegeist Freethe (iOS 2026: captures 'grabs' from live input onto a multitouch canvas, Spectral mode = additive resynthesis; no keyboard pitch found; VS: thebeatcommunity.com). Paulstretch/PV_Freeze/NessStretch as algorithms (V: research/synthesis.md §2.8). None is a polyphonic per-finger source whose Höhe scrubs the instrument's own past and whose Puls plays it rhythmically → rare, not new (Clouds/Beads/Panharmonium do 'play the recent past at pitch', Anderson Freeze does 'tune the frozen spectrum'). In-app relative: Körner with src = 'echo' already grains the last 8 s of the master output with Höhe = position in the material (V: APP 1722, 4753–4759, 4968) – Bernstein differs by phase-randomised smoothness, Kamm cross-synthesis and the note-on-anchored 'past', not by the idea of playing one's own echo.

cost_detail.measured: Plain-JS complex radix-2 FFT, Float64, twiddle/bit-reversal tables, Node 22 x64 [M: research/bench/fft_check.js]: IFFT 2048/4096/8192 = 128/155/353 µs (the idea's '150 µs je Block' is right for 4096). One synthesis hop at N = 4096 (transposition + nearest-harmonic comb + power + random phase from a table + IFFT + window + OLA) = 270 µs × 23.4 hops/s = 6.3 ms per audio second = 1.09 Nebel units (1 unit = 5.81 ms/s, webaudio.md §4). With a forward analysis FFT every hop (what the formula 'Rahmen = Schreibzeiger − …' implies, since the write pointer moves) = 410 µs → 1.66 units. N = 2048: 0.81 / 1.25; N = 8192: 1.34 / 1.98.
cost_detail.comb_as_written: C_k = Σ_n Gauss(…) over all harmonics per bin = 2 ms per hop at 440 Hz = 46 ms per audio second = 8.0 units [M] → must be the nearest-harmonic distance (one Gauss per bin, included in the 1.09 above) or a table refreshed only when f changes.
cost_detail.optimised: real-valued IFFT (N/2 complex, ≈ half the FFT cost) + cache the shaped magnitudes until f/y/detune change → ≈ 0.5–0.75 units steady state (A, from the measured parts); the idea's 0.7 is reachable only this way.
cost_detail.L3: second phase set L/R (+1 IFFT per hop) + 32 band random walks ≈ 1.7 as written, ≈ 1.0 optimised (idea: 1.2)
cost_detail.ohr: not needed: the app's capture ring CAP.ringL/R (8 s, main thread, fed by myzel-tap in 2048-sample chunks, tapped from A.out = master, V: APP 5168–5215, 5260) already serves Körner-Echo; the main thread can post the N-sample frame (≤ 32 KB, transferable) on note-on and on y changes. A worklet-side ring with an input processor would cost ≈ 0.1–0.2 once (pass-through with input ≈ 0.19 measured) and give sample-exact anchoring.
cost_detail.phone: ×1.0–1.5 (A); at L1 one Bernstein voice ≈ one Nebel voice, three fingers ≈ 3.3 of the 14-unit mobile budget

failure_modes: Specification contradiction: the frame formula anchors to the moving write pointer, so holding a finger does not freeze – it plays a sliding spectral smear of 'd seconds ago' (a spectral delay line, analysis every hop, 1.66 units), while the pitch and 'Scrubbing ohne Zeit' promise a freeze anchored at note-on; anchoring at note-on is the musical version and halves the cost (magnitudes are held until y moves).

Onset latency: windowed OLA at hop N/2 reaches full level only after N/2 samples = 43 ms at 4096 (85 ms at 8192) plus the 0.3 s attack → held notes feel late, Puls hits (gate 0.22 s) are mushy and arrive ≈ 60 ms after the Puls grid unless the first two hops are pre-rolled at note-on.

Pitch ambiguity: a frozen frame of a chord or reverb tail has no f_ref; the transposed magnitudes only recolour, the perceived note comes from the Kamm at f – at kamm 0.4 the note is weak against a loud frozen chord, at kamm 1 it is a vocoder-like buzz. Needs kamm ≥ 0.6 by default and a shaerfe that follows velocity.

Self-listening converges: the ring is the wet master (post-reverb, post-insert), so Bernstein freezes its own freezes; RMS normalisation stops level runaway but each generation smears further toward grey noise shaped by the reverb – Lucier as promised, but after 3–4 generations every note sounds the same (the Kamm is what keeps it pitched).

Random-phase identity: Paulstretch wash is the sound of every freeze effect (Frostbite, Clouds spectral); without a played history it falls back to MAT material and becomes a Körner-like pad with fewer features than Körner. The distinction is behavioural (Höhe = time travel, Puls = rhythmic past) and must be taught.
Bebung: r and the Kamm follow detune only per hop (23 Hz at 4096) → vibrato is stepwise; recomputing the shaping per hop during vibrato costs the full 1.1 units (no caching).

Memory/time: an 8 s hold with y moving after the ring has wrapped points at overwritten material (new 'past' arrives) – either snapshot the scrub window per note-on (≤ 4 s mono ≈ 768 KB per finger) or accept that the past is only 8 s deep.
Window 8192 at L3: 85 ms hop → smoother but doubles onset latency; fine for drones, wrong for Puls.
fixes: anchor at note-on; analyse only on note-on and when y moves by > one hop; hold M_k otherwise
nearest-harmonic Kamm (one Gaussian per bin) or a per-f table; real-valued IFFT; cache shaped magnitudes until f/y/detune change
pre-roll two hops at note-on (output full at t = 0); N = 2048 for Puls lanes, 4096 held, 8192 only L3 and never for bursts
kamm default 0.6, shaerfe ∝ velocity; optional pitch estimate of the frame (autocorrelation, main thread, once per analysis) to set f_ref
reuse CAP ring + ensureCapture() instead of a second ring; if a dry past is wanted, tap A.insertOut into the same tap node
generation counter per frame (tag the ring with 'how often has this been frozen') and cap at 2 → stops the grey convergence
verdict: Selten, nicht neu: „die eigene Vergangenheit bei Tonhöhe spielen“ gibt es als Eurorack-Puffer (Clouds, Beads: Freeze + Position + 1V/Okt), als spektralen Resynthesizer (Panharmonium: Freeze, gespeicherte Spektren per 1V/Okt), als getunten Freeze-Effekt (Anderson Freeze, Spectral Freeze Pro) und als Freeze-Apps (Frostbite, isxynth, Freethe 2026) – und Myzels Körner spielen mit „Echo (letzte 8 s)“ bereits die eigene Vergangenheit mit Höhe = Position; neu ist nur die Kombination je Finger mit Kamm-Kreuzsynthese und Puls. Worklet-machbar, aber doppelt so teuer wie behauptet: ein Synthese-Hop bei N = 4096 kostet gemessen 270 µs = 1,1 Einheiten (0,7 nur mit reeller IFFT und gecachter Spektralformung), 1,7 wenn der Rahmen wie formuliert am Schreibzeiger hängt und jeden Hop neu analysiert wird, und der Kamm „Σ über alle Harmonischen je Bin“ kostet 8 Einheiten – er muss die Nächste-Harmonische-Distanz sein. Musikalisch steht und fällt es mit drei Entscheidungen, die die Spezifikation offen oder falsch lässt: Verankerung bei Note-on (sonst ist es kein Freeze, sondern ein spektrales Delay), Vorlauf von zwei Hops (sonst kommen Puls-Stöße 60 ms zu spät), und Kamm ≥ 0,6 mit f_ref (sonst hat ein eingefrorener Akkord keine Tonhöhe); dazu konvergiert das Selbst-Hören über den nassen Master nach wenigen Generationen zu grauem Rauschen. Mit diesen Korrekturen ist Bernstein ein echtes Verhaltens-Novum (Zeitreise unter dem Finger, der Puls spielt die Vergangenheit), ohne sie ein teurer Freeze-Effekt, der Körner-Echo nachbaut.
marks: V = source read, VS = WebSearch summary, M = measured here, A = inference
